verdict.rationale: Checkout.com is API-first with a REST/idempotent API, SDKs (Node.js), OAuth2 client-credentials auth, webhooks, and a test-account/sandbox environment, all of which support headless automation and CI usage; the MCP server also has a live auth-gated remote endpoint suitable for scripted/CI-driven agent workflows. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples or GitHub Actions integration docs, no independent hands-on report confirming headless CI usage, and no dedicated 'headless mode' framing beyond general API/SDK docs.
